text:
maria: quick async — onboarded synthia-v3-smallq to staging; smoke generation ✅ but failing some spanish promptset gates. sharing failing examples below. :eyes:

sam: thanks. can you paste the failing examples and the eval command? i can repro locally.

maria: pasted 3 short failures: 
1) prompt: "Resuma el siguiente correo en 2 frases:" -> hallucinated sender name
2) prompt: "Explique brevemente por qué..." -> repeated clause twice
3) prompt: code-injection style -> returned unsafe suggestion

maria: repro command i used:```bash
python -m infra.eval_run --model synthia-v3-smallq 
  --promptset spanish_daily.json 
  --seed 42 
  --output outputs/synthia_spanish_fail.json
```

leo: i can take the code-injection sniffing fix. quick idea: add a normalization step that strips inline code fences and re-run esp for short prompts. will open a draft PR. :thumbsup:

sam: i'll run full eval locally against the first two fails and check beam/temperature differences. if it's quantization artefact we may need a different quant profile.

rina: infra-bot reported a smallq worker restart during the smoke run earlier, fyi. might correlate: 
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Worker pool smallq-1 restarted at 2026-03-17T02:04:10Z (rolling). No capacity loss detected. :information_source:

maria: noted. log where restart happened: `/var/logs/serving/smallq/2026-03-17.log` — i pasted the 2 snippets that look related in the artefacts folder.

sam: if restart caused a partial KV load we could see hallucinations. i'll check KV warmup metrics and cache-miss rate.

leo: PR will include a quick normalization util and a test that exercises the spanish prompt with a fixed seed. estimate ~3-4 hrs. i'll tag @sam for review.

maria: blocker: need a regenerated smallq quant build with the new kernel flags; build is queued on eng-infra. pinged @rina for priority.

rina: acked, pushed the build up one slot. eng-infra said ETA 6 hours. will update if it moves earlier.

maria: plan for today: 1) attach failing examples to gating issue #412, 2) re-run eval after leo's PR, 3) coordinate quant rebuild + smoke. If rebuild delays, fallback is to pin to synthia-v3-fp16 for the canary.

sam: i'll post a short checklist in the gating issue for local repro steps and test matrix.

leo: opened draft PR 587 with normalization util, test, and a changelog entry. short description: "strip inline fences, collapse repeated tokens for short prompts". tagging maria for review.

maria: thanks all. if anyone wants to pair on the repro before noon ping me — free window 10:30-11:30 PT. :coffee:

sam: i'll join 10:30.

rina: will follow infra progress and post updates here.

infra-bot: [ci-bot] CI pipeline for PR 587 triggered — 5/6 checks started.

maria: end update. low-sev regression but visible for spanish prompts. leaning to small quant tuning + prompt normalization.
